question: Theophrastus is called the father of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Botany**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Theophrastus** is considered the** father of botany** for his works on plants.
 
• Theophrastus**(371-287 BC), a Greek native of Eresos in Lesbos, was the successor to Aristotle in the Peripatetic school.**
 
• His given name was** Tyrtamus was given by Aristotle for his 'divine style of expression'.**
 
• The interests of Theophrastus were wide-ranging,** extending from biology and physics to ethics and metaphysics.**
